mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the subject, topic or idea being put forward."
The theme is the subject, topic or idea being put forward.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to cover a jump in time or place, or other apparent forms of discontinuity."
BRIDGING SHOTS are used to cover a jump in time or place, or other apparent forms of discontinuity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to identify a location and they have traditionally been used to introduce a scene or situation."
ESTABISHING SHOTS are used to identify a location and they have traditionally been used to introduce a scene or situation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the individuals who are portrayed in the story."
The characters are the individuals who are portrayed in the story.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is that which shows no match between two back-to- back shots."
The JUMP CUT is that which shows no match between two back-to- back shots.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major raw material for the script prepare."
A good outline is a major raw material for the script prepare.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a professional and leader of the film production team."
The director is a professional and leader of the film production team.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those who do not see the reason to admit that there higher beings; how much more worship any."
Non- religious people are those who do not see the reason to admit that there higher beings; how much more worship any.
